body.title: Hyperspy
body.description: Thanks to the nice guys developing Hyperspy, who have produced a module providing tools to interact with The EELS Database, including automatic spectra downloads. http://hyperspy.org/hyperspy-doc/current/api/hyperspy.misc.eels.eelsdb.html

body.title: Digital Micrograph Scripting
body.description: Dave Mitchell has kindly developed a DM Script to allow importing of EELSdb MSA format spectra into Digital Micrograph. http://www.dmscripting.com/import_msa_eels_spectrum_from_eelsdb.html

body.title: THe EELS Database at EMC
body.description: I will be at the EMC in Lyon next week and I will present several works including one poster session on the EELS DB (IM08-407, Poster session C). Do not hesitate to contact me if you want to discuss about the website or other matters. Luc

body.title: JEELS 2016
body.description: The conference JEELS 2016 will be held in Tarragona, Spain (June 28th-30th 2016) and is organized by Dr. Raul Arenal (U. Zaragoza, Spain) and Dr. Sonia Estrade (U. Barcelona, Spain). More delails here.

body.title: The EELS Database recognized by re3data as Open Access
body.description: The EELS database has been recognized as an Open Data research repository by the global Registry of Research Data Repositories organization re3data (see also Pampel et al., 2012). The EELS database can thus be included in data management plans, fulfilling an  common requirement found within numerous funding agency grant proposal processes.

body.title: EELS DB website goes live
body.description: After a long incubation time spent removing lots of bugs and doing a lot of testing, the new EELS DB website is finally having its training wheels removed. The site is now visible to all users without registration, and we have no plans to wipe the database – so you’re free to upload your data […]

body.description: After nearly one year of work, it’s our pleasure to announce that the new EELS database website goes beta.
